name.description: The short friendly name of the server load balancer

description.description: The long description of the server load balancer

nfc.description: DEPRECATED AND REPLACED (USE 'network_enforcement_node' INSTEAD) Network Function Controller that should manage this SLB. Can be skipped if there exists only 1 NFC in the system, or if there are no NFCs, in which case, the server would auto-deploy an NFC to manage the new SLB (and any SLBs created thereafter). Cannot be used along with network_enforcement_node

network_enforcement_node.description: Network enforcement node that should manage this SLB. Can be skipped if there exists only 1 NEN in the system, or if there are no NENs, in which case, the server would auto-deploy an NEN to manage the new SLB (and any SLBs created thereafter). Cannot be used along with nfc

devices.description: Management configuration of the devices associated with this SLB Network VF.
